verdict.rationale: Elastic documents self-managed deployment options, including on-prem or private/public cloud (elastic-docs-13, elastic-docs-48) and a one-line Docker quickstart (elastic-docs-5, elastic-docs-17). Community users confirm running it themselves on Kubernetes via the ECK operator or StatefulSets (elastic-comm-8, elastic-comm-9), and one values the Elastic License option precisely because it lets them self-host (elastic-comm-20). The openness caveats are real but don't negate self-hosting: the source-available SSPL/Elastic licensing conflicts with some companies' open-source policies (elastic-comm-16), and the documented quickstart is for local dev/test and ships with a one-month trial license (elastic-docs-39). Missing for 10: production-grade self-managed install documentation in the evidence, clarity on which core features stay free after the trial, and an OSI-approved license for the core product.
